description_en: Queries the list of cloud recording download tasks
description_zh: 调用该接口查询云端录像下载任务的列表
name: QueryRecordDownloadJobList

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview tab of the IoT Platform console
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页签，查看当前实例的ID
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of devices to display on each page in the response. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 指定返回结果中每页显示的设备数量，最大值是50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the video device belongs.

You can view the information of all products under the current instance on the Products page of the IoT Platform console (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/product) or by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html operation.

<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
视频设备所属产品的ProductKey。

您可以在物联网平台控制台 (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/product)的产品页面或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html接口，查看当前实例下所有产品的信息。

<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName。
</notice>
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The device name of the video device. You can view the DeviceName of devices under a specified product on the Devices page of the IoT Platform console (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/devices) or by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69905.html operation.

<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
视频设备的设备名称。您可以在物联网平台控制台 (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/devices)的设备页面，或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69905.html接口查看指定产品下设备的**DeviceName**。

<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey。
</notice>
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The device ID of the video device. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html operation to query the device ID.

<notice> IotId is a globally unique identifier of a device and corresponds to a combination of ProductKey and DeviceName on a one-to-one basis. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. If you specify IotId together with ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
视频设备的设备ID。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html接口查询。

<notice> IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName组合是一一对应的关系。如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName组合，则以IotId为准。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en: The page number from which to start displaying the results. Pages start from page 1 by default
parameters.help_zh: 指定从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。默认页数从1开始排序
parameters.name: current_page

Code.description_en:
The status code of the call.

If the call is successful, 200 is returned.
If the call fails, an error code is returned. For more information, see Error codes in this topic
Code.description_zh:
调用结果状态码：

调用成功，返回200。
调用失败，返回错误码。详细信息，请参见下文错误码

Data.description_en: The task list returned if the call is successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功后，返回的任务列表

JobList.description_en: The details of the cloud recording download tasks
JobList.description_zh: 云端录像下载任务的详细信息

BeginTime.description_en: The start time of the query range. The value is a 10-digit UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds. Value range: 0 to 2147483647
BeginTime.description_zh: 查询范围起始时间，格式为10位的时间戳，单位为秒。取值范围为0~2147483647

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the query range. The value is a 10-digit UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds. Value range: 0 to 2147483647
EndTime.description_zh: 查询范围结束时间，格式为10位时间戳，单位为秒。 取值范围为0~2147483647

FileName.description_en: The file name. This parameter is returned only when Type is set to 1
FileName.description_zh: 文件名，Type为1时，显示该参数

JobErrorCode.description_en:
The error reason of the task. This parameter is returned when Status is -1. Valid values:

9441: network exception.
9442: audio or video data error
JobErrorCode.description_zh:
任务异常原因，当Status为-1时返回异常信息：

9441：网络异常。
9442：音视频数据错误

Progress.description_en: The generation progress of the recording file. Value range: 0 to 100
Progress.description_zh: 录像文件生成进度，范围为0~100

RecordType.description_en:
The recording type. Valid values:

0: continuous recording.
1: event-triggered recording.
2: active recording.
4: local-to-cloud recording.
99: mixed type
RecordType.description_zh:
录像类型。

0：连续录像。
1：事件录像。
2：主动录像。
4：本地上云录像。
99：混合类型

Status.description_en:
The generation status of the recording file. Valid values:

-1: The recording file generation is abnormal.
0: The recording file has been generated.
1: The recording file is being generated
Status.description_zh:
录像文件的生成状态。

-1：录像文件生成异常。
0：录像文件已生成完毕。
1：录像文件正在生成中

StreamType.description_en:
The stream type. Valid values:

0: main stream.
1: sub stream
StreamType.description_zh:
码流类型。

0：主码流。
1：辅码流

Type.description_en:
The download type. Valid values:

1: download by file.
2: download cloud recording of the device by time range.
3: download local recording of the device by time range
Type.description_zh:
下载类型。

1：按文件下载。
2：设备云端录像按时间范围下载。
3：设备本地录像按时间范围下载

Url.description_en: The download URL of the cloud recording. The URL is valid for 1 hour
Url.description_zh: 云端录像下载地址，有效期为1小时

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful.
true: The call is successful.
false: The call fails
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
